summary: Alterity Therapeutics Limited, an Australian foreign private issuer, filed Form 6-K with the SEC for September 2026. The filing is solely a Change of Director's Interest Notice for director Marks, submitted as Exhibit 99.1. It also incorporates the 6-K by reference into existing registration statements on Form S-8 and Form F-3. No corporate transaction, special situation event, or strategic action is disclosed; the contents are routine administrative director shareholding disclosures. Accordingly, this filing does not qualify as a special-situation category; it is an ordinary current report under Rule 13a-16.
